### NHI Announces Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call Dates


October 7, 2026


MURFREESBORO, Tenn.


, Oct. 7, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- National Health Investors, Inc. (NYSE:NHI) announced details for the release of its results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. NHI plans to issue its earnings release after the market closes on Monday, November 9, 2026, and will host a conference call on the following day, Tuesday, November 10, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time to discuss the results. The number to call for this interactive teleconference is (888) 506-0062, with the access code 260192.


The live broadcast of the conference call will be available online at[www.nhireit.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4791245-1&h=420774654&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.nhireit.com%2F&a=www.nhireit.com) and at[https://www.webcaster5.com/Webcast/Page/633/54463](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4791245-1&h=3161544820&u=https%3A%2F%2Fnam10.safelinks.protection.outlook.com%2F%3Furl%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.webcaster5.com%252FWebcast%252FPage%252F633%252F54463%26data%3D05%257C02%257Cdhambly%2540nhireit.com%257C388829d61c0b481b24a008defe2d7967%257Cd8faea977a4d4343a8f80d2d506e0a30%257C0%257C0%257C639227669111119608%257CUnknown%257CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%253D%253D%257C0%257C%257C%257C%26sdata%3DrmwRzKUmSO8zq9kL4RCzIyM49Lkh18VcC7I0rQckWWA%253D%26reserved%3D0&a=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.webcaster5.com%2FWebcast%2FPage%2F633%2F54463) on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time. The online replay will be available shortly after the call and remain available for one year.


**About National Health Investors, Inc.**
National Health Investors, Inc. (NYSE:NHI), established in 1991, is a self-managed real estate investment trust specializing in sale-leaseback, joint venture, mortgage and mezzanine financing of need-driven and discretionary senior housing and medical facility investments. NHI operates in two reportable segments: Real Estate Investments and Senior Housing Operating Portfolio ("SHOP"). NHI's portfolio consists of independent living facilities, assisted living and memory care communities, entrance-fee retirement communities, senior living campuses, skilled nursing facilities and specialty hospitals. For more information, visit[www.nhireit.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4791245-1&h=979880845&u=https%3A%2F%2Fpr.report%2Fh3lw&a=www.nhireit.com) .
